style: High-end industrial science-fiction videogame hero sculpt. Photoreal machined materials with deliberate large readable panel shapes.

items.subject: Original rescue exo-courier, athletic human proportions, substantial asymmetric segmented burnt-orange left shoulder pauldron over a graphite ceramic exosuit. Chiseled dark smoked visor with a single narrow luminous amber horizontal light, contrasting pale gunmetal jaw and collar. Cropped cobalt-blue textile cape tabs mounted flat against upper back, compact safety-orange courier pack, ribbed flexible joints between distinct armored chest, waist, pelvis, forearms and greaves. Empty gloved hands, high-tread boots. Crisp machined edges with selectively worn metal, subtle white reflective rescue stripes and fine vent grooves; no weapons, helmet horns, platform, text, or logos. Unobstructed limbs and neck, no dangling or floor-length fabric.
